issues.detail: The Greek 'αλληγορουμενα' (allēgoroumena) is a passive participle meaning 'allegorized' or 'spoken of allegorically'. The Vietnamese translation 'lời ví dụ' (parable/example) changes the grammatical function and meaning from an allegorical description to a specific literary genre.

The Greek 'απο ορους σινα' (apo horos Sina) means 'from the mountain of Sinai'. The Vietnamese translation 'tại núi Si-na' (at the mountain of Sinai) changes the prepositional sense from origin/source to location.
